# isagent

> Like isbot, but for AI browser agents. Browser library that detects AI browser agents (Claude in Chrome specifically; CDP/Puppeteer/Playwright-style automation, ChatGPT agent and Browser Use generically) on a web page and reports which form fields they filled and how. MIT, no dependencies, ~7 KB gzipped, no network requests.

## Integrate

- Script tag (load early, in <head>): `<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/isagent.js@1/dist/isagent.min.js"></script>` then `isagent.start({ formField: "agent_detection" })`.
- npm: `npm install isagent.js`; `import { start } from "isagent.js"; const detector = start({ formField: "agent_detection" });`
- With `formField`, every FormData built from a form (submit, form.submit(), new FormData(form)) gets a JSON field: `{ v, verdict: "agent"|"suspected"|"none", agent: "claude-in-chrome"|"chatgpt-agent"|"browser-use"|"playwright"|"unknown"|null, active, score, claude, signals: ["name:count"], fields: ["selector:method"] }`.
- JSON APIs: include `detector.summary(formElement)` in the request body.
- Server: treat as an advisory signal (client-controlled). Use for confirmation steps, review queues, analytics; do not hard-block (assistive tech can trigger generic signals).

## API

- `isagent.isAgent(detector?)` -> boolean quick check
- `isagent.start(options) -> Detector`
- `detector.report()` -> `{ verdict, detected, agent, active, score, claude, agents, signals[], filledFields[] }`
- `detector.summary(scope?)` -> compact JSON for servers
- `detector.agentFill(element)` -> `{ method: "form_input"|"synthetic-typing"|"insert-text"|"programmatic-click"|"synthetic-event"|"no-user-input", ... } | null`
- Options: `formField`, `threshold` (0.85), `onSignal`, `onDetect`, `onFieldFill`, `onActiveChange`, `frames`, per-watcher booleans (`overlay`, `markers`, `favicon`, `forms`, `keyboard`, `mouse`, `environment`).
- Window events: `isagent:signal`, `isagent:detect`, `isagent:fill`, `isagent:active`.
